faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DMRC Head Operations recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DMRC Head Operations recruitment is 11th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Head Operations post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in any engineering discipline to be eligible for the Head Operations position at DMRC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Head Operations post is 58 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the DMRC Head Operations recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for the DMRC Head Operations recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Head Operations post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Level 14 (Rs. 144200-218200) CDA or Rs. 120000-280000 IDA or equivalent, depending on the engagement type.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the DMRC Head Operations position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by sending the filled application form along with required documents to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Head Operations role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Personal Interview and a Medical Fitness Examination.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Head Operations post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Head Operations post in the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation / Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the DMRC official website, and a direct link is provided in the Important Links section of this article.
